descriptionHtml:
16.5cm of two-layer foam. Three sides. A base that grips.

Martindale is a memory foam bolster dog bed, 104 × 68.5 × 16.5cm, with two foam layers, three bolstered sides, an open front and a non-slip base.

The beds in this house have lasted about 18 months each and you stopped expecting better. The filling wanders into the corners, the middle goes hard, and it is shabby by the second winter.

What decides whether a bed is worth having in year three sits under the cover: memory foam to take the shape, over an egg-crate layer to carry the weight.

What they get

  • 16.5cm of two foam layers: Memory foam on top, egg-crate underneath.
  • Three bolstered sides: An edge for a chin, a back or a hip.
  • An open front: No wall to stand on and crush flat on the way in.
  • A non-slip base: It stays put on wood, laminate and tile.

Best for: dogs who flatten the edge climbing in, and slippy floors.

Why it is worth the money

£185, and nearly all of it is under the cover. Two foam layers is the specification brands skip at this price, because a photograph cannot show it. The core carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee, and £185 spread across those 1825 nights is about 10p a night. Nothing rides on the guess either. Inside 100 nights we take it back from the UK mainland and refund in full.

Now the awkward part. 104 × 68.5cm is not a giant-breed footprint, and £185 is not small for it. You are buying the two foam layers and the grip underneath, not floor area.

Size and fit

SizeExternal (cm)Suits
One size104 × 68.5 × 16.5Dogs who curl or lean rather than sprawl

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the bolsters take up some of that. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

The fleece and linen-effect cover comes off and follows its sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most

Is 104cm enough for mine?

Measure them side-on, add 15 to 20cm, then compare with 104 × 68.5cm.

How fast is delivery?

Free over £40. The window for your postcode shows at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment options appear at checkout.

Will it slide on laminate?

It is non-slip underneath. That is the main reason to choose this one.

Is it right for a stiff dog?

The front is open and the base does not travel. The rest is for your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

The cover does, by its label. Dry it right through before refitting.

What if it is ignored?

Then the 100 nights take it back off your hands at no cost.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
